_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: The coil conditions (supply constriction, crowded shorts, dead liquidity floor) suggest a breakout is coming, but the 0% 7-day score-movement base rate and analyst's 0-for-18 forced-direction track record make HOLD the only statistically defensible call until a confirmed breaker appears.
next_move.brains_agree: Partial — analyst explicitly calls HOLD forward; narrative implies UP but does not state a forward call. The analyst's self-awareness about its own false-UP history overrides the narrative's bullish framing.
next_move.confirmed_if: Score breaks above 62 (Disbelief upper bound) with funding sustaining above 0.01% and stablecoin growth turning positive
next_move.invalidated_if: Score drops below 54 (Complacency upper bound) with VIX spiking above 20 and ETF flows reversing below 80
